name: Sharanra
source:
Main character Sasayama has recently lost his job due to recession. He gets to see a request for a male AV actor in a job magazine. He's accepted for the job and allowed to choose from five amateur actresses.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角筱山最近因经济衰退而失业。他在一份招聘杂志上看到了招聘男AV演员的要求。他接受了这份工作，并被允许从五名业余女演员中进行选择。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-december-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
